# apple_app_event_localization (Resource)

Sets the name and descriptions of an in-app event for one locale. An event has one localization per locale. To show an image or a video on the event card or details page, create an `apple_app_asset_library_placement` with this localization's ID as `app_event_localization_id`. Destroying the resource deletes the localization. Import it by ID or with `<app_event_id>/<locale>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_event_localization" "en_US" {
  app_event_id      = apple_app_event.summer.id
  locale            = "en-US"
  name              = "Summer Cup"
  short_description = "Compete for the summer title."
  long_description  = "Win matches all month to climb the leaderboard and take the cup."
}

# The image on the event card.
resource "apple_app_asset_library_placement" "card" {
  image_id                  = apple_app_asset_library_image.card.id
  app_event_localization_id = apple_app_event_localization.en_US.id
  placement_type            = "EVENT_CARD_ASSET"
  placement_group           = "DEFAULT_PROFILE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_event_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the in-app event, e.g. `apple_app_event.example.id`. Changing it creates a new localization.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`. Changing it creates a new localization.

### Optional

- `long_description` (String) Description shown on the event details page, up to 120 characters.
- `name` (String) Name of the event, up to 30 characters.
- `short_description` (String) Summary shown on the event card, up to 50 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_event_localization.en_US
  identity = {
    id = "7c1d2e3f-4a5b-4c6d-8e7f-9a0b1c2d3e4f"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id> or <app_event_id>/<locale>
terraform import apple_app_event_localization.en_US 6449876543/en-US
```
